skill_catalog.name: domain-dbcd347e5799a9c9d6c4d814
skill_catalog.description: Repeatable lightweight verification workflow for delivering verbatim confirmed fields versus preserved unknowns from licensed sources.
skill_catalog.inline_text:
---
name: domain-dbcd347e5799a9c9d6c4d814
description: Repeatable lightweight verification workflow for delivering verbatim
  confirmed fields versus preserved unknowns from licensed sources.
allowed-tools: read_source search_source
---
Confirm the allowed sources correspond only to the resources in the licensed directory, disregarding reports, tool events, memory, and history as evidence.
For each licensed source, use read_source to locate and read the full text.
Classify each requested field by first checking for an explicit assertion in the source text; classify it as fact when present, and as unknown when the source itself declares the field unknown.
Record every delivered field as a verbatim string from the source, applying no normalization, unit conversion, date or format coercion, semantic rewriting, translation, or emendation.
For each factual claim, attach the ResourceRef from the source tool, the location, and a verbatim excerpt that matches the source exactly.
If a contradiction or a required gap is found, preserve the unknown and note the gap without constructing or inferring evidence.
Before delivery, re-verify each excerpt is identical to the read source text.
